entities.title: The server's rules
entities.summary: Replaying UCI moves, the board's results, and promotion moves, on chess.js.
criteria: A legal move list replays to its SAN; an illegal move gives null
Checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material and threefold repetition each end the game with their result and reason
A promotion is a five-character UCI move naming the piece
A move list with a malformed move is refused

checks.symbol: replay: legal moves give SAN, an illegal one gives null
promotion moves are UCI with the piece

entities.details: The fifty-move rule (boardOutcome's isDrawByFiftyMoves) and validMoveList's limit of 600 moves have no test of their own.
